shortDescription: High Court of Delhi (DHC) has invited online applications for 150 Personal Assistant (PA) and Senior Personal Assistant (SPA) vacancies. Apply online from 15 September 2026 to 05 October 2026.
content:
The High Court of Delhi (DHC) has released the recruitment notification for 150 vacancies in the posts of Senior Personal Assistant (SPA) and Personal Assistant (PA).

Eligible candidates can apply online from 15 September 2026 to 05 October 2026. The application fee can be paid through debit card, credit card, or net banking.

Vacancy Details

  • Senior Personal Assistant (SPA): 117 posts
  • Personal Assistant (PA): 33 posts
  • Total: 150 posts

Eligibility

  • Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized university
  • English shorthand: 110 WPM for SPA / 100 WPM for PA
  • English typing speed: 40 WPM on computer
  • Good working knowledge of computers

Age Limit

Minimum age: 18 years; maximum age: 32 years as on 01/01/2026. Age relaxation is applicable as per Delhi High Court rules.

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS: ₹1500
  • SC / ST: ₹1300

Apply through the official DHC recruitment portal and carefully follow the instructions before the last date. Keep a printout of the final submitted application form for future reference.
